before: A participant seeds a new room, uploads the whole room state, and receives it back from a Hocuspocus server. The first participant can receive a loaded room twice.
after: A server can seed a new room with createCollaborationState before any participant syncs. Participants join the seeded room, upload nothing, and receive the room once. The example servers flush the loaded room before the first participant joins.
reason: The server builds the room with the same seed path as compaction: the current format, one seed record, and a new room generation. Released clients join it as any seeded or compacted room. A client that holds an earlier copy of a re-seeded room is refused by the generation gate before its state merges.
